title: Add a ResolvedInfoSection holder for the search-filtered, locale-resolved copy
description: InfoSection was just changed (previous task) to hold resource IDs instead of resolved text, since the top-level infoSections list can't call stringResource() directly. The dialog's search box filters on actual displayed text, so InfoDialog needs a resolved (String-holding) counterpart built inside its @Composable body — this is that holder type. Declared on a single line so its title/body fields can never be mistaken for InfoSection's (now-renamed) fields by later anchor-based edits.
acceptance_criteria: A new private data class ResolvedInfoSection(val title: String, val body: String) is added, declared on one line
No existing declaration is modified by this task
exact_code: private data class ResolvedInfoSection(val title: String, val body: String)
